title: MemoryQueryPlan / memory broker
root_cause: Agent runtime treats memory bindings as opaque IDs and cannot resolve bounded, trustworthy runtime context.
source_requirement: Replace bare bindings with a project-scoped MemoryQueryPlan and brokered materialization.
implementation_steps: Define scope, class/tier, byte/token/item budgets, trust, freshness, conflict, provenance, and writeback fields.
affected_tests: Agent runtime and memory fabric tests.
evidence_required: Positive, isolation, budget, stale, conflict, and writeback vectors.
rollback: Disable broker materialization and retain unresolved blockers rather than injecting raw bindings.
acceptance_criteria: Every materialized memory item is bounded, scoped, trusted, fresh, and provenance-bound.
Foreign or conflicting context fails closed.
